cell.label: Diagnosis of ITP based on suggestive history, CBC, and PBS
cell.path: Platelets 20,000 to 30,000 and no profound bleeding

cell.label: Individualize therapy; outpatient regimens include: prednisone 1 mg/kg/d by mouth; WinRho IV; IVIG IV; or dexamethasone burst. Platelet response?
Consider: cytoxan, Cellcept, or rituxan.
cell.path: Platelets <20,000 to 30,000 after a 3- to 12-month trial

cell.label: Maintain therapy, consider taper and observation.

footnotes.footnote: If bleeding is not present, outpatient therapy may be initiated.
